author: Monty
candidate: CORNERSTONE 300 nm SiN, TE, nominal 1550 nm

core_binding.geometry_status: recipe only; no placement, routing or mask generated

default_mzi_mismatch: mzi_nc defaults to mmi1x2_nc at its input; explicitly replace it with mmi2x2_nc for the two-input exchange
required_extensions: heated arms with electrical ports and selected heater geometry
port phase trims and block-to-bypass phase matching
all optical routing and crossings with foundry design-rule review
fiber interfaces, detector routing and external preparation/analysis modules
model_boundary: the pinned heater() raises NotImplementedError; default optical models are not a measured phase-voltage map or a device fidelity certificate

external_bench_modules.preparation: one calibrated 2x2 balanced splitter and relative phase, patched per setting
external_bench_modules.analysis: relative phase followed by one calibrated 2x2 balanced splitter, patched per setting
external_bench_modules.guard: one removable/bypassable 2x2 MZI on paths 4 and 16

boundaries: published nominal values and software defaults are not measured fabrication dimensions
pinned software API and provider stack do not certify full layout compatibility
no license-restricted software accessed, no fabrication order, no instrument job
